capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV "69 kWh total" for the Standard (US-oriented page); bare capacity treated as gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 69 kWh (ArenaEV, gross) x 60/64 (usable-to-nominal ratio of the LFP Juniper Standard on EV Database). Pack equality between the two pages is not proven (EV Database lists a 64 kWh pack).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV: liquid-cooled LFP; Wikipedia: standard trims LFP.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Teslabs (2025-01) says no manual battery-preconditioning control exists, only navigating to a charger; EV Database listings say the battery is warmed automatically when navigating to a charger. Tesla manuals were not fetchable (403). Navigation preconditioning is an over-the-air software feature across Tesla models; Teslabs gives no model years. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

Estimated: Listing for the same model family says preconditioning is possible and starts automatically when navigating to a charger. Combined with the Teslabs no-manual-control statement. dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV (Standard, 2025-) and Wikipedia both give 225 kW max for the Standard; EV Database lists 175 kW for the European Juniper RWD, which conflicts.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Thechargeport: Standard RWD and AWD are at the 7.7 kW end of the 7.7-11.5 kW range (North America). Wikipedia says up to 11.5 kW on all variants, ArenaEV/EV Database list 11 kW (EU), so sources conflict; Tesla Model 3 service manual says 48 A only with the Long Range battery. ArenaEV lists 11 kW (Type 2).
